coverage.dsp_scope: paired first stage only, at most four multiply nodes; downstream DSP choices remain uncalibrated
coverage.added_in_version_3: kernels of one to seven rows, strides of one to three rows, blocks without a pool, 11-bit inputs, up to 16 filters, first stages with a fill-cycle row schedule
coverage.added_in_version_4: 12-bit inputs and a graph fanout of 17, both from packaged model 17 (dev_m17_engines); the widest values measured before were 11 bits and a fanout of 15

notes: Development measurements made with coverage opened, plus ordinary conversions under version 2 coverage. prediction_error_cycles is measured II minus predicted frame cycles; observed range -9 to +3, and -2 to +3 for plans whose every convolution stage uses shared arithmetic. Native-stage estimates are uncalibrated lower bounds and are not compared. dev_m17_engines was also routed out of context (one core: LUT 46,659, FF 37,259, DSP 539, BRAM 35 tiles, WNS +0.310 ns); that routed result is a development comparison. Ordinary conversion reports predictions, not timing or fit certificates.

dense_matrix_overhead.meaning: interval of a sequential Dense matrix stage minus its steps; the estimate uses the largest measured value
dense_matrix_overhead.note: Measured after the product reduction was moved out of the accumulator loop. Before that change the 512-multiplier stage of the Dense-32 shape missed routed timing at 5 ns by 0.253 ns (final_dense32).
